from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Form, HTTPException from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse app = FastAPI() # Dummy session flag for illustration purposes logged_in = False @app.get("/login") async def login(): global logged_in logged_in = True return {"message": "Logged in"} # Existing hello world endpoint (preserved) @app.get("/hello") async def hello(): return {"message": "Hello, world!"} # Registration GET: show form @app.get("/register", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def get_register(request: Request): if not logged_in: raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Unauthorized") html_content = """ Patient Registration

Register New Patient








""" return HTMLResponse(content=html_content, status_code=200) # Registration POST: process form @app.post("/register") async def post_register(name: str = Form(...), age: int = Form(...), email: str = Form(...)): if not logged_in: raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Unauthorized") # Basic presence validation is handled by Form(...) # In a real app, you'd store the patient data here. return {"message": f"Patient {name} registered successfully"}

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app, logged_in

client = TestClient(app)


def test_register_get_unauthenticated():
    # Ensure logged_in flag is False to simulate unauthenticated access
    global logged_in
    logged_in = False
    response = client.get("/register")
    assert response.status_code == 401


def test_register_get_authenticated():
    # Simulate login
    client.get("/login")
    response = client.get("/register")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    # Check that form fields are present
    html = response.text
    assert "name=\"name\"" in html
    assert "name=\"age\"" in html
    assert "name=\"email\"" in html


def test_register_post_success():
    # Ensure we are logged in
    client.get("/login")
    data = {
        "name": "John Doe",
        "age": "30",
        "email": "john@example.com"
    }
    response = client.post("/register", data=data)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    json_resp = response.json()
    assert json_resp["message"] == "Patient John Doe registered successfully"
